dimensions.assessment: Directly impacts the members and governance of the Lytton Rancheria of California.
dimensions.evidence: the Lytton Rancheria of California is subject to the Act of June 18, 1934... and the Secretary of the Interior may acquire and take into trust land for the benefit of the tribe

dimensions.assessment: Provides significant legal and administrative status changes regarding tribal land trusts and reservation boundaries.
dimensions.evidence: Land taken into trust pursuant to subsection (a) shall be part of the reservation of the Lytton Rancheria of California

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes the Department of the Interior to acquire land into trust, but specifies no exact monetary amounts or appropriations.
dimensions.evidence: the Secretary of the Interior may acquire and take into trust land for the benefit of the Lytton Rancheria of California pursuant to section 5 of that Act

dimensions.assessment: Applies a specific statutory framework to one named tribe and grants specific trust-acquisition authority to the Interior Department.
dimensions.evidence: Notwithstanding any other provision of law, the Lytton Rancheria of California is subject to the Act of June 18, 1934

dimensions.assessment: Establishes permanent trust status and reservation designation for any land acquired under the provision.
dimensions.evidence: Land taken into trust pursuant to subsection (a) shall be part of the reservation of the Lytton Rancheria of California

missing_information: Specific acreage or locations of land to be taken into trust
importance_detail.rationale: Affirms the applicability of the Indian Reorganization Act to the Lytton Rancheria of California and authorizes land to be taken into trust as part of their reservation.
